hibernate-mapping.query: from Shop as s where s.klantId = :KlantId order by s.id asc
from Shop as s where s.klantId = :KlantId order by s.factuurDatum desc
from Shop as s where s.klantId is null order by s.id asc
select count(klantId) from Shop as c where c.klantId = :Id
select f from Shop as f where id in (:ids)

from Shop as s where s.openstaandBedrag > 0 and s.factuurDatum is not null and (s.eersteHerinnering is null or (year(s.eersteHerinnering) = year(:HerinneringDatum)) and month(s.eersteHerinnering) = month(:HerinneringDatum) and day(s.eersteHerinnering) = day(:HerinneringDatum)) and s.tweedeHerinnering is null and s.factuurDatum < :EersteHerinnering

from Shop as s where s.openstaandBedrag > 0 and s.factuurDatum is not null and s.eersteHerinnering is not null and (s.tweedeHerinnering is null or (year(s.tweedeHerinnering) = year(:HerinneringDatum)) and month(s.tweedeHerinnering) = month(:HerinneringDatum) and day(s.tweedeHerinnering) = day(:HerinneringDatum)) and s.eersteHerinnering < :TweedeHerinnering
select distinct(f) from Shop as f join f.betalingen as b where not b.betaalDatum is null and b.betaalDatum >= :BeginDatum and b.betaalDatum <= :EindDatum order by f.factuurNummer
select distinct(f) from Shop as f where f.totaalBedrag - f.totaalBetaald > 0 and not f.factuurDatum is null and f.factuurDatum <= :Datum order by f.factuurNummer

select distinct f from Shop as f join f.betalingen as betaling where (not betaling.betaalDatum is null and betaling.betaalDatum >= :BeginDatum and betaling.betaalDatum <= :EindDatum) order by f.factuurNummer
select distinct f from Shop as f join f.betalingen as b where (not b.betaalDatum is null and b.betaalDatum >= :BeginDatum and b.betaalDatum <= :EindDatum)
